title: Say which panes have died
notes: Shipped. A pane that exits now shows up on the manager page as `terminal 1 · exited`, red, and Enter on that row takes you to it to press Enter again. The exited flag has always existed and nothing ever read it; onExit redraws now, which is the whole of what was missing. Dead beats asking: a shell that rings on its way out is listed as exited, not waiting, because answering it finds nothing to answer. The tab does not go yellow for a dead pane — yellow means asking today, and giving it a second meaning is a change to the terminals screen, not this page. PR #18.
